programme.desc: Mientras investigan el asesinato de un infante de marina, el equipo de NCIS descubre un laberinto de cámaras espías que transmiten en vivo, escondidas en las habitaciones de un motel de Virginia.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: El equipo de NCIS investiga el asesinato de un músico de la banda más elitista de la Armada que actúa en eventos diplomáticos en todo el mundo.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Amor perdido
programme.desc: Erin se enfrenta en la corte a su exesposo, Jack (Peter Hermann), quien está defendiendo al hombre que ella intenta condenar por asesinato. Mientras tanto, Danny y Baez investigan para determinar si el esposo está detrás del asesinato de su esposa.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Ni rendición, ni retirada
programme.desc: Después de que Reggie Wilson (Cyrus Farmer), un testigo en un caso anterior de Erin, le pide ayuda para desmantelar una operación de drogas en su edificio de apartamentos, ella se propone hacer que el edificio sea seguro para su familia.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Interferencia extranjera
programme.desc: Danny y Baez se unen con dos agentes rusos para buscar a un peligroso hombre ruso que ingresó a EE. UU. con una visa diplomática.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: La delgada línea azul
programme.desc: Cuando Danny intercepta un envío de varios millones de dólares que estaba destinado a un cártel de drogas en México, se convierte en un blanco cuando ellos regresan en busca de venganza.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando un seguidor de un conocido orador motivacional es asesinado, el equipo sospecha del propio orador.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Una serie de extraños rituales de asesinato conducen al equipo en busca del asesino.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC se dirige al sur para investigar a un veloz asesino cuya firma coincide con la de un asesino en serie de hace 30 años. Además, el equipo descubre que alguien los sigue e imita los crímenes que ya han resuelto.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando Reid descubre que su novia fue secuestrada por su acosador, él y el equipo de la UAC se reúnen para encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Stories of the Hidden Worlds
programme.desc: Makoko is a neighbourhood across the 3rd Mainland Bridge located on the coast of mainland Lagos. A third of the community is built on stilts along the lagoon and the rest is on the land. The waterfront part of the community is largely harboured by the Egunpeople who migrated from Badagary and Republic of Benin and whose main occupation is fishing. In July 2012, the Lagos State government ordered that some of the stilts beyond the power-lines be brought down without proper notice. This led to the destruction of several stilts on the Iwaya/Makoko waterfront and many families were rendered homeless.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.sub-title: Behind The Draw - "We Found My Target Buck Dead… But My Best Season Yet
programme.desc: Mike's Missouri bowhunting season started with heartbreak when he discovered his #1 target buck dead from EHD. What could have been the end of his season turned into an unforgettable journey. His wife tagged an early-season buck, both of his sons filled their tags, and finally Mike ended the rollercoaster with a big Missouri whitetail of his own.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: Hunting Land Man - "Heading North, Missouri Food Plot Prep
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade and the crew head north to scout out, plan, and put in the plots to lay the groundwork for this falls hunting season in the Midwest!
Adam Hays returns to familiar Alberta terrain with unfinished business - the pursuit of Moto Moto, a black bear so elusive that no hunter has ever laid eyes on him other than by trail camera.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.sub-title: The Reel American Road Trip - "Trout fishing with Nate and Nick in Dahlonega Georgia
programme.desc: Danny meets up with Nate and Nick at a secret location for some monster trout fishing. Later we find out what mead is at a local brewery.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Todd Rogers embraces the business of being a hunting outfitter as a labor of love. And while so many family-run operations are dwindling in rural America, the Rogers legacy is here to stay. Will Cooper and Josh Dahlke return to western Oklahoma to share this story while pursuing brush-country whitetails in the red dirt.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.sub-title: The WoodHaven Way - "Same Time, Same Place
programme.desc: Years of hunting the same piece of ground teaches you that some patterns are worth trusting. WoodHaven's Josh Anderson heads back to the family property for a mid-October hunt, relying on years of history and a pattern that has produced time and time again. With the calendar lining up, Josh climbs into a stand that seems to come alive around the same time every October.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.sub-title: The WoodHaven Way - "The Legend of Forky
programme.desc: Every great hunting property has a buck that becomes part of its history. In 2017, that buck was "Forky" for Pat Reeve of Driven Hunter. Just days before Minnesota's archery opener, Forky began regularly visiting a strategically placed waterhole, giving Pat the confidence that opening weekend could be something special. With months of preparation leading up to the season, everything came down to being in the right tree at the right time.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.sub-title: The Bearded Buck - "Third Times A Charm
programme.desc: Illinois is one of those coveted midwestern states that every whitetail hunter dreams of hunting. In this episode, Jerry and Austin finally make their way to this buck paradise to hunt with our good friends Jack Ficarra and Dylan Thomsen at 5 Seasons Outfitters. With rut kicking off, the guys are hoping that they will get to experience some of the magic that Illinois is known for.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Dan Cabela is on a mission to better understand how wild-harvested protein contributes economically and culturally to society in North America. Join him as he learns more about the Wild Harvest Initiative and sets out to harvest his own food for the freezer.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips

programme.desc: The work of German writer D. F. Strauss argues that the Gospels are best understood as containing history-like stories that intend to convey truth but do not occur as they are narrated, which is why most scholars find his approach illuminating.

programme.desc: Before the Gospels, accounts of Jesus are passed on by word of mouth; whether it is possible to move "behind" the written accounts to learn more about this original oral tradition, and perhaps even about Jesus himself as a historical person.

programme.desc: In addition to the New Testament, other written sources about Jesus come down from antiquity; what these other, noncanonical Gospels are like; considering their origins and sources; how much they can reveal about what Jesus actually says and does.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.desc: Mark Twain is a celebrity of almost mythic status; explaining the origin of Samuel Clemens's famous pseudonym; asking what Mark Twain means to his American audience and to the man who creates him.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.sub-title: From Samuel Clemens to Mark Twain
programme.desc: Seeing Twain's life as one of milestones; the financial success brought by his literary triumphs is at times disrupted by disastrous investments such as the Paige typesetting machine; Twain's happy married life is hit by several family tragedies.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.sub-title: The Sense of Mark Twain's Humor
programme.desc: Twain says that as a humorist, "I have always preached."; his sermon consists of "cracking up" idols of reverence to make room for truth; his speech about the "cannibals" of the Sandwich Islands shows him tickling the audience's funny bones.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.desc: Concerning his writing, Twain once confesses that the motive of profit has an importance "almost beyond my own comprehension."; exploring why money means so much to Twain; detailing the marketing schemes he uses to maximize his income.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.desc: Henry Ward Beecher organizes Twain's trip East as a pilgrimage to pay obeisance to the founding monuments of Western culture; how Twain turns the tables; whether Twain is psychologically preparing America for its role as a world power.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.desc: Twain's goal in "Innocents Abroad" is to teach his readers to see the Old World with their own eyes, asking what of value can remain after everything is mocked into submission when Twain trains his wit on the holy sites of the Bible.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.desc: Twain mines his own past as a prospector and turns it into comic frontier fiction in "Roughing It"; the work also marks Twain's first prominent use of American vernacular language; his intimation that it deserves a place in American literature.

programme.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain
programme.desc: Despite the rigors of touring and the limitations imposed by his audiences' tastes, Twain comes to love the thrill of live lecturing; he skillfully blends the serious academic content that audiences demand with his own trademark sardonic wit.
